# Locallify

> Locallify is a software studio based in Silchar, Assam, India. We design and
> build custom software, web apps, mobile apps, and AI features for clients
> across Cachar, the Barak Valley, India, and worldwide — with SEO and
> Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) engineered into every build so what we
> ship actually gets found on Google and cited in AI search.

## Core services

- Custom software & SaaS (internal tools, admin portals, workflow systems)
- Web apps & products (Next.js / React)
- Mobile apps (iOS + Android, React Native)
- AI features & voice agents
- n8n & workflow automation
- SEO + GEO systems (schema, Core Web Vitals, entity clarity, answer-ready content)
